# Independent residue audit of Clean/

2026-10-31. Read-only audit of the 24 grey-box Python files, 5,227 source lines. Output: `tasks/clean-code/residue-audit-codex.md`.

Verdict: substantial residue remains in configuration, serialization and historical adapters. The core tensor inputs and useful runtime choices should stay. There are **31 grouped proposals**, all intended **bitwise** on existing supported numerical paths; **0 rounding proposals**. These are static judgments, not numerical verification, and no production changes were made.

The inventory has **3053 rows**. Categories overlap. Counts are occurrence/surface counts, not unique knobs: a field, its JSON output, its import check, its numeric literal and a tool diagnostic each get their own row. Verdicts partition the rows. There are 81 emitted config keys, including 25 fixed literals; P02 removes 24 of those while retaining CODE as the native schema discriminator. Combined proposals remove 44 emitted config entries. Nine metadata-only ClassVars, the Lambda_combo pipeline and 13 unread nominal matrix buffers account for most avoidable state.

## Proposals ranked by how much they clean

The ranking favors removing whole compatibility mechanisms and producer chains before local spelling or labels. IDs are stable, not ranking numbers. Each row below the summary names its proposal where applicable. Bitwise here means unchanged numerical operations/results, not identical JSON keys, checkpoint bytes or console text. A schema change has its own migration and harness cost.

Supported final component pairs need no tensor conversion while schemas stay unchanged. Thesis whole dumps require mainline unpickling and component export. Bitwise; 45 linked occurrence rows. |

## Patterns and the items behind them

| Pattern | Evidence | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| Mainline compatibility inside production configuration | config.py:146-162, _CLEAN_KEYS, all 81 JSON output/check rows, MODE/ENCODER_INIT/NX_ANN aliases | P01, P02, P03, P07 move conversion outward and retain actual native choices |
| Metadata masquerading as functionality | use_f64 does not choose dtype; lbfgs does not gate polishing; joint_estimation is passed to an ignored argument; validation_measure only labels the fixed score | P03, P08, P09; actual dtype, architecture and score guards remain |
| Dead state has a producer chain | blocks.py:152-175 builds nominal matrices that live tuple matrices replace; RMSE_baseline feeds only Lambda_combo | P04, P05 remove construction plus persistent state, not just variable names |
| Duplicate saved facts and a verification disk mirror | pair hp/orig_run_id/start_phase/resume metadata; val_hist.npz versus production loss.npz | P06, P31; preserve actual resume state, model selection and requested loss data |
| Defaults that imply nonexistent paths | mats/pass_mats=None after K14 removed the fallback; params_init/combo_init/sys_data/yfuture=None; discarded x | P12, P14 require valid inputs or remove a silently ignored one |
| Cheap options that are real | CPU/CUDA, eager/compiled, lfr/closed, resume source, roots, return_pred, folder, verbosity, chunk/device/append_value helpers | Keep because actual computations or useful user choices consume them; interface alone is not the reason |
| Hidden dependency readers make static dead-code claims unsafe | deepSI consumes ids/init_model_done; list window dispatch always passes force_multi_u/force_multi_y/online_construct | Keep the actual dependency seam; P15 makes its supported behavior explicit |
| Unlabelled choices mixed with structural literals | budgets, physical constants, normalization floors, stream offsets, plotting layout and retry timing; every numeric occurrence is listed | P21-P25 add rationale; structural axes, identities and exact tensor dimensions need no new trash variables |
| Provenance prose and misleading history | obc_ref_successor and i+1 claims without stored successors; mainline-order text; unused origin assignments | P26-P28 retain licensing and numerical eligibility while exposing what is history |
| Small source habits | three redundant int casts, 14 unused unpacked slots, three shared default objects, .data inside no_grad | P16-P20; no algebraic rearrangement or random-stream change |

## Scope, method and limits

Read the requested handoff sections 1 to 14, the merged keep-audit sections 2 and 3, amendment 9 and its implementation choices, the mainline config meaning and the former interface rules. The Claude residue audit was never read. Clean/blackbox and Clean/data_generation were excluded. No training, harness, suite, numerical experiment, checkpoint load or git write was performed. Forbidden Telica data paths were not read. Only this report is written.

Enumeration used a fresh AST/token pass over the 24 files: module assignments; all dataclass/ClassVar fields; every argument including self/cls, variadics and defaults; if/conditional/boolean/comprehension/loop/exception/assert selectors; CLI choices and literal keyword flags; numeric literal occurrences; metadata outputs/checks; registered buffers and direct/implicit nn.Linear parameters; and historical/provenance comments. Every source item has its own row, with a column to distinguish repeated literals on one line. Concrete default-network keys supplement the variable-depth parameter patterns. The three empty package initializers have zero items, as shown in coverage.

Reader searches were textual and AST-based, followed by source inspection. One read-only Explore delegate searched outside Clean, as permitted by handoff section 14. Generic harness captures were inspected too: an unchanged spelling or an interface reader is not by itself a keep reason. Runtime inputs stay when used by the actual calculation, when genuinely settable for a useful run, or when guarding invalid input with an actionable error. User-requested loss data and the actual resume/source ledger are distinguished from redundant legacy snapshots. Comment rows use the comment verdict to say what should be retained or rewritten without pretending prose is a runtime selector.

Labels are evaluated on the current source. THEORY/HEURISTIC headings governing coherent adjacent blocks count; untagged formulas and general docstrings do not. All 830 numeric occurrences are included, including labelled ones; 750 numeric occurrence rows lack such a label. The category also counts unlabeled named settings, so its total is larger. A keep on an unlabelled structural index/identity/exact coefficient is deliberate: the expression and its computation explain its value; no per-zero constant or variable is proposed.

Prior callable rulings stand unless this new field/key/default evidence is explicit in the row/proposal. K7/K11/K29/K32 were not explicitly implemented/kept by amendment 9. K11's old unused-folder claim is now false because evaluation loads twins with folder=cfg.data_root. K6's val_data argument is explicitly unread, unlike its useful verbose flag. K35 is revisited only for the newly traced verification-only disk schema, not its live event/score history. K3/K17/K18/K21/K30/K34 useful options and readable helpers remain. Jan's class/function/file identities are not renamed or moved by a cosmetic proposal; rows touching Jan definitions are marked, and the P31 historical exporter is project-added. P26 and the header-pointer part of P27 explicitly require Dirk to supersede previous marker/documentation policy.

## Checkpoint and external-reader costs

Clean's own _best.pth and _last.pth are necessary: _rerun_source reads them, and fit writes them during validation. Removing the whole format would break a real Clean resume. Supported final thesis component pairs have statically matching key patterns, block order, coordinate version 2, encoder maps and sequential network layout. This supports config-only conversion before P04/P05, not a claim that every thesis binary loads. No binary was loaded. After P04/P05, old pair loading additionally needs explicit filtering of Lambda_combo and the 13 nominal keys, because training.py:96-106 rejects extra keys.

Thesis mainline whole dumps are different: their pickle classes include SSE_Interconnect_Composed, Reduced_Gantry_State_Block, linear_encoder_init_aug and live_g_feed_forward_nn, absent from Clean. Export those dumps to components under the mainline environment. The L4 strict pair load at l4_loader.py:468 provides no proof of mainline whole-dump compatibility.
